pcps.title: Four-Concept Separation + BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD Terminal Status
pcps.rationale: V3 FINAL silent-promotion bug exposed need for 4-concept separation + 4th terminal status
proposed_changes: Add BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD as 4th terminal status in §16
Formalize PATENT_STATUS, ENGINEERING_STATUS, BUYER_SENTIMENT, BUYER_READINESS in §7/§16

approval_rules: The agent who files a PCP cannot approve it.
CEO approval must be explicit (written 'approve PCP-NNN').
Until APPROVED, PCP is advisory only — no invention may use proposed statuses as constitutional.
When APPROVED, a new constitution version (V1.N+1) is created; old version preserved.
